Numbers: the keywords `Abs`, `Sgn`, `Mod` and `Pi`, trigonometry (in degrees), rounding, powers and logarithms, and bit functions. The converting functions are in [Types](Language-Features-Types), random numbers in [Randomization](Language-Features-Randomization).
